title: [bundle] Fix the agent navigation gap where top-level help promises h
objective: Fix the agent navigation gap where top-level help promises hf help <command> but most common commands such as resume status claim checkpoint test done drift release reopen handoff ship lease version and policy return unknown command. Add focused help coverage or a clear supported-command fallback so agents can navigate every common/lifecycle command without contradiction, while preserving unknown-command fail-closed behavior. Prove hf help for common commands exits 0 and unknown commands still exit nonzero.
acceptance_criteria: hf help for every command named by the top-level common-command help exits 0 and prints focused usage or command guidance.
hf help for lifecycle/navigation commands resume status claim checkpoint test done drift release reopen handoff ship lease version and policy exits 0.
Unknown commands and unknown help topics still fail closed with a nonzero exit code.
Regression coverage is added for the expanded help contract.
